answer: Pinewood Federal Credit Union is in our e-payoff network, so we confirm your payoff directly with them at your appointment and send the payoff the same day. Two things come out of what you receive: the $99 home pickup fee, and the loan payoff itself, so you get the amount left over. Your payment then arrives by bank draft or by direct deposit in 1 to 3 business days. Keep making your loan payments until Pinewood confirms the payoff; if they receive an extra payment, they refund it directly to you, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed.
